title: Hotel Resort Casino Dream
content: Was anybody else some place like this last night? I was at a hotel resort type place that felt like it was in Las Vegas. The hotel seemed like it had a casino with slot machines but I didn't spend time there.I had a dream I was at a social gathering at a hotel/resort. It seemed like I knew some of the people in the dream,but no one "looked" familiar to me, like people I knew IRL. It felt like it was some kind of reunion.
